Question: In Table 1 of the EIA Idaho Electricity Profile 2024, what net generation in megawatthours is listed for Electric utilities?

A. 6,560,126 megawatthours
B. 13,475,312 megawatthours

Source citation: Idaho Electricity Profile 2024 (https://www.eia.gov/electricity/state/idaho/index.php)

Supplied draft answer: A
